creator: Alexander Terp
description:
NOTICE covers Ghostty and herdr, and build_bundle stages licenses/herdr/LICENSE into muster.app. Nothing covers swift-protobuf (Apache-2.0, pinned at 1.38.1 in Package.resolved), whose runtime library is linked into the shipped binaries rather than only generating code at build time - nor the ~90 Rust crates in Cargo.lock that end up inside libmuster.dylib and muster-bridge.

Deferrable while nothing works yet and nothing leaves this machine, which is why this is not in next. It stops being deferrable the first time --bundle output goes to somebody outside the project, and that is the kind of thing that happens on a day nobody planned it. Worth doing before then rather than after.

The mechanical half is easy - cargo-about or cargo-bundle-licenses can generate the Rust set - so most of the work is deciding what the bundle should carry and where, and whether the gate should fail when a new dependency arrives without a license beside it.
title: 📜 The bundle ships licenses it does not carry
